daily_quests.title: ASX 200 Price Momentum Ranking
daily_quests.description: Using the ASX 200 historical prices dataset, write a SQL query with window functions to calculate the 30-day price momentum for each stock. Use ROW_NUMBER() to rank stocks by momentum within each date partition, and LAG() to compare current price against the price 30 days ago. Return the top 10 stocks with highest positive momentum on the most recent date in the dataset, showing stock symbol, current price, price 30 days ago, momentum percentage, and rank. Use a CTE to calculate the momentum in a separate step for clarity.

daily_quests.title: NSW Road Crash Data Cleaning & Aggregation
daily_quests.description: Download the NSW Road Crash Data from data.nsw.gov.au. Load the CSV into pandas and perform the following: (1) Remove rows with missing values in critical columns (crash date, severity, location). (2) Convert crash date to datetime format. (3) Create a new column 'month_year' extracted from crash date. (4) Group by month_year and severity to count crashes per severity level per month. (5) Calculate a 3-month rolling average of total crashes. (6) Export the cleaned and aggregated data to a new CSV file named 'nsw_crash_summary.csv'. Print summary statistics showing trend direction (increase/decrease) over the last 6 months.

daily_quests.title: Australian Wine Production ETL Pipeline
daily_quests.description: Build a Python script that extracts Australian wine production data (by region and variety) from wineaustralia.com or a Kaggle wine dataset. (1) Use pandas to clean the data: handle missing values, standardize region names, convert production volumes to consistent units (tonnes). (2) Create a SQLite database with a schema containing tables for regions, varieties, and production facts. (3) Use SQL to write a query that ranks wine regions by total production volume across all varieties in the most recent year, and calculates year-on-year growth percentage. (4) Create a second query using a CTE to identify 'emerging varieties' (varieties that increased production by >20% YoY). (5) Export both query results to separate CSV files. Include error handling for missing data and log the ETL process with timestamps.
